6229.title: OAuth metadata ignores a compatible public method
6229.rootCauseOneLine: The metadata parser rejects a non-none singular method without inspecting the supported-methods list for the server-supported public alternative.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — addresses the observed branch; not executed
prReviews.topFinding: Authentication policy needs maintainer review; validate all plural-list entries and conflicting declarations.

6229.proposedFix: Review and validate explicit public-method negotiation at the metadata boundary while retaining all authorization checks. Authentication changes are excluded from automatic fixing.
6229.caveats: Source-only reproduction in two clean clones by the same agent. No live client metadata, authenticated browser flow, deployed revision, or contributor code was tested. The full reproduction is embedded inline; no raw artifacts are published.
